name: XDKNet 2.5.18
body:
Android TV 2.5.18. No server plugin update is needed: XDKNet plugin
2.1.0.16 (Emby 2.0.5.16) stays current.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Playback

- A show or film whose stream stops loading part way through now reopens
  where it stopped, instead of ending with "The stream stopped loading". If
  it stalls again straight away, it reopens converted by the server, which
  gets past a file the TV's player keeps getting stuck on.

## Find intros (Jellyfin, for the server's admin)

- A series, season or episode page has a new **Find intros** in its Admin
  controls, when the server runs the Intro Skipper plugin. It has Intro
  Skipper look again for intros, recaps and credits: in every season from a
  series page, or in one season from a season or episode page. The window
  shows each season as it is scanned, then how many episodes got an intro
  and a recap. Segments changed by hand are kept. It can be closed at any
  time; Intro Skipper carries on with the scan on the server.
- **Look for recaps in subtitles**, on by default, turns on Intro Skipper's
  subtitle recap search for the seasons scanned. The audio match that finds
  intros rarely finds a recap, since a recap is different in every episode.
  The subtitle search finds one that opens with "Previously on…" in a text
  subtitle (SRT or similar), embedded or beside the file.
- A show without text subtitles needs **Detect recaps using black frames**
  turned on in Intro Skipper's settings on the server; the window says so
  when a scan found no recaps.
- Recaps from subtitles need Intro Skipper 12 or later. Older Intro Skipper
  still scans, one season at a time, and finds intros as before.
- Skipping uses what was found from the next episode played. How intros and
  recaps are skipped is set in Settings > Playback & SyncPlay > Automation &
  Queue > Skip Segments.
